You are applying as a cook and have three years of restaurant experience. This scene covers the opening, your basic background, and practical timing questions before detailed work questions begin.
Learner: Cook. Partner: Manager.
Not in this scene: duties and kitchen tasks, tools and stations, salary, hiring decision.

6. ask when they need an answer — slot: none
